full.title: The spark: Sarajevo, 1914
bullets: 28 June 1914: Archduke Franz Ferdinand is shot by Gavrilo Princip.
Austria-Hungary blames Serbia and sends a harsh ultimatum on 23 July.
A crisis in the Balkans becomes a crisis for all of Europe.

full.title: The alliance system
bullets: Triple Entente: France, Russia and Britain.
Triple Alliance: Germany, Austria-Hungary and Italy.
A war between two countries could pull in all of them.

full.title: Militarism
bullets: An arms race between the great powers.
Britain and Germany race to build battleships (HMS Dreadnought, 1906).
Detailed war plans, like Germany's Schlieffen Plan.

full.title: Imperialism and nationalism
bullets: Rivalry for colonies and trade.
Nationalism in the Balkans and Serbia's ambitions.
Old empires afraid of breaking apart.

full.title: From July crisis to world war
bullets: 28 July: Austria-Hungary declares war on Serbia.
1 and 3 August: Germany declares war on Russia, then France.
4 August: Germany invades Belgium and Britain enters the war.
